JANUS_SPIRE2_KEYWORD_PERK.title: Rally
JANUS_SPIRE2_KEYWORD_PERK.description: If you lack Energy to play this card, [gold]Exhaust[/gold] cards from your [gold]Diary[/gold] to cover the shortfall, 1 per missing Energy.
JANUS_SPIRE2_KEYWORD_COLLECTION.title: Keepsake
JANUS_SPIRE2_KEYWORD_COLLECTION.descript: At the start of combat, put this card into your [gold]Diary[/gold].
JANUS_SPIRE2_KEYWORD_COUNTERATTACK.title: Counterattack
JANUS_SPIRE2_KEYWORD_COUNTERATTACK.descr:
When you take damage (even [blue]0[/blue]), create and play a copy of each [gold]Counterattack[/gold] card in your Hand, from left to right, then [gold]Exhaust[/gold] the copies.
Each card can trigger up to its current cost, resetting at the start of your turn.
JANUS_SPIRE2_KEYWORD_STICKER.title: Sticker
JANUS_SPIRE2_KEYWORD_STICKER.description:
Can be [gold]Upgraded[/gold] any number of times.
For every [blue]4[/blue] [gold]Sticker[/gold] cards in your [gold]Exhaust Pile[/gold] with the same name and Upgrade level, remove them and add a new [gold]Sticker[/gold] card with that name and 1 higher Upgrade level to your [gold]Diary[/gold].
JANUS_SPIRE2_KEYWORD_TRANSCRIBE.title: Transcribe
JANUS_SPIRE2_KEYWORD_TRANSCRIBE.descript:
After this card is played, add a [gold]copy[/gold] of it to your [gold]Diary[/gold].
The following effect is active while this card is in your [gold]Diary[/gold].
JANUS_SPIRE2_KEYWORD_RECORD.title: Record
JANUS_SPIRE2_KEYWORD_RECORD.description: If this card would enter your [gold]Discard Pile[/gold] after being played, put it into your [gold]Diary[/gold] instead.
JANUS_SPIRE2_KEYWORD_RECOLLECTION.title: Recollection
JANUS_SPIRE2_KEYWORD_RECOLLECTION.descri: While this card is in your [gold]Diary[/gold], meeting the following condition lets you play it through the [gold]Extra Hand[/gold]. After playing it, trigger [gold]Recollection[/gold] again to play it this way.
JANUS_SPIRE2_KEYWORD_INSPIRATION.title: Inspiration
JANUS_SPIRE2_KEYWORD_INSPIRATION.descrip: [gold]Inspiration[/gold] X: During your turn, if your [gold]Hand[/gold] isn't full, right-click this card outside your Hand and [gold]Exhaust[/gold] X cards from your [gold]Diary[/gold] to put it into your [gold]Hand[/gold].
